review_pass_1: Separate internal scientific/syllabus review checked official CSIR syllabus and mirrored SET scope; indexed primary evidence for SGR Mg-dechelatase and isotope tracing in autophagy mutants; authoritative reviews of PAO pathway, petal senescence, abscission, nutrient mobility, chloroplast remodeling, fluorescence and fruit maturation. Distinguished chlorosis, terminal death, abscission, cosmetic stay-green and organ-specific maturation; corrected source-loading terminology. Recomputed content, isotope, fluorescence and carbon examples and quantitative assessment answers.
review_pass_2: Separate internal teaching/examination and static technical review of actual saved chapter: 142 unique prose paragraphs in 15 ordered sections; no exact overlap with 5.D.07 comparator (13,436 words and 138 paragraphs). Corrected ambiguous Q27 and added section-specific evidence, references and links. Checked 52 answer keys against four options and 3 incorrect-option explanations; 13 correct answers per position. Inspected diagram labels, captions and zoom targets; verified tag nesting, all anchors, ARIA and reader IDs. No external review or browser runtime test.

quality.assessment: Internal rubric judgment, not external certification. Deductions: selected primary records/reviews rather than exhaustive primary full text, necessary conceptual recurrence, worked datasets illustrative rather than measured, straightforward foundational distractors and no external difficulty calibration, static rather than browser/assistive technology checks.
